RSK-001Partial

Portfolio exposure by product, segment, geography, channel, and partner

Core · Risk & Portfolio · Owner: Enterprise Risk

Acceptance boundary

Portfolio exposure by product, segment, geography, channel, and partner is accepted when tenant-scoped execution fails closed on invalid authority or evidence, retains auditable lineage, and the cited automated control-family tests pass.

Current maturity and gap

Remaining gap for RSK-001: production-grade institutional configuration, external-provider or assessor evidence where applicable, and witnessed operating-effectiveness validation are not yet complete.
